zh-CN.title: 八仙聚力领取与分享优化
items: 每日发言凝聚的仙力改为在活动页手动领取，获取过程更加明确
活动支持直接转发给会话，奖池预览也加入合并气泡与仙境位置卡片

en.title: Baxian Force claiming and sharing refined
items: Force gathered from daily posts is now claimed manually on the event page for a clearer reward flow
Events can be forwarded to chats, while prize previews now include grouped bubbles and mythical location cards
